variants.thick_left: left page of a thick book (300+ pages), strongly curved toward the gutter
variants.thick_right: right page of a thick book
variants.thin: a page of a thin book or magazine
variants.lifted: page edge lifted; not held down by hand
variants.oblique: shot at an oblique angle of 30–45°
variants.dim: dim room with a single light, where some shadow falls

variants.footnote: book page with small print, such as footnotes, references or an index
variants.fineprint: print dense with small text, such as terms and conditions, a manual or a newspaper

variants.formula: textbook or workbook page with many formulas
variants.grid: page mixing tables and formulas, or a form with many boxes

variants.r90: page top points right in the photo
variants.r180: page is upside down in the photo (its top at the photo bottom)
variants.r270: page top points left in the photo
variants.skew_pos: page turned about 30° clockwise, then shot
variants.skew_neg: page turned about 30° counter-clockwise, then shot
variants.exif: phone held flat, parallel to the desk, shooting straight down (EXIF orientation is often wrong)

variants.pattern: on patterned fabric, a blanket or a tablecloth
variants.wood: on a desk with strong wood grain
variants.mess: on a desk with many objects, such as other papers, pens and cups
variants.hands: book held in the hand while shooting; fingers over the page edge

strata.name: small page (under 20% of the photo area)

variants.far: A4 sheet or book page shot from far away; the page covers under 20% of the photo
variants.card: small document, such as a business card, receipt or note
variants.corner: small page off in a corner of the photo

variants.topdown: flat single sheet (A4 printout, etc.) from straight above
variants.oblique: flat single sheet at an angle; perspective only
variants.form: flat form with tables or boxes

strata.name: no page, occluded, cut off, neighboring page

variants.none: photo without a page (empty desk, room)
variants.occluded: fingers or objects cover part of the page
variants.cut_off: one side of the page is cut off by the photo frame
variants.neighbor: aimed at one page of an open book, but the neighboring page shows a lot

variants.spread_top: both pages of an open book, from above
variants.spread_oblique: both pages of an open book, at an angle
